verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago ships developer tooling (MP CLI, MCP server, Claude Code plugin, SDKs), so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains no mention of telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The access-token security discussion is about a different subject and does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
